title: Fantasy Guardian Scene
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy landscape features a white-haired woman with a rainbow mane holding a large blue shield emblazoned with pinecones, the letters FC and FF. To her left stands a green patterned dog, while a golden dragon, cherry blossoms, ancient ruins, a large red moon, and a floating armored figure populate the mystical background.
prompt: Highly detailed fantasy scene at night with a pale woman with long flowing pastel rainbow hair holding a blue shield decorated with pinecones and the letters FC FF. A green patterned dog stands beside her on stone steps. In the background a golden dragon coils near cherry blossom trees, ancient stone ruins, gears, a large glowing red moon in a purple cloudy sky, and a floating armored knight. Butterflies, glowing orbs, and mystical atmosphere fill the composition.
